lines.text: Mom just texted me. I'm outside. Open the door.
But Mom was upstairs, asleep. I'd said goodnight to her an hour ago.
I opened the doorbell camera. A woman stood on the porch, smiling and waving. It was Mom.
I typed, what's my middle name?
She got it right. Then came a second text. Whatever is upstairs, do not answer it.
On the camera, the woman stopped smiling. She mouthed one word, over and over.
